description: Unit tests for D3D11 copying texture wrapper in media GPU Windows implementation, including mock classes for video processor proxy and texture wrapper, and tests for processing and HDR metadata handling.

classes.name: MockVideoProcessorProxy
classes.description: Mock implementation of VideoProcessorProxy for testing, with methods to simulate initialization, creation of views, blitting, and setting color spaces and HDR metadata.

classes.name: MockTexture2DWrapper
classes.description: Mock implementation of Texture2DWrapper for testing, with methods to simulate texture processing, initialization, and HDR metadata setting.

classes.name: D3D11CopyingTexture2DWrapperTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for parameterized tests of CopyingTexture2DWrapper, testing various success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: CopyingTextureWrapperProcessesCorrectly
methods.description: Test that verifies the process of copying texture wrapper, including color space handling and output.

methods.name: HDRMetadataIsSentToVideoProcessor
methods.description: Test that verifies HDR metadata is correctly sent to the video processor proxy.
